issue_context.title: Consider checkpoints for size based retention
issue_context.body:
**Use case. Why is this important?**

Currently we are not considering checkpoints in the size based retention which could be significant at times (especially now that we are truncating a larger portion of WAL).

We need to consider it's size for the retention.
comments: I will like to take this up.

My bad. While talking to @Harkishen-Singh offline on unit tests in #7969, we realised it late that we are already counting the checkpoint. See: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/19c190b406c992278aaade63be92ecc7bb6a4921/tsdb/wal/wal.go#L898

It takes the entire directory which includes even the checkpoint.
